name: zclass_typelist_update_all_buckets
description: zClass_TypeList::UpdateAllBuckets scans the six callback-priority bucket head slots and, for every non-empty bucket, updates that bucket and then runs the global node-update pass.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass type-list and node-callback source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x44ea70 validates iterating the six g_zClassCallbackPriorityHeadSlotPtrs entries, loading each pointed-to bucket head, skipping null buckets, calling zClass_TypeList::UpdateBucket for non-empty buckets, and following each bucket update with zClass_Class::gwNodeUpdateAll.

The native zClass smoke stages two callback-priority bucket heads and verifies UpdateAllBuckets dispatches both through the accepted UpdateBucket callback path while preserving non-pending links and restoring deferred processing.
